name: fsx-ontap-diagnostic
description: Diagnoses Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP performance and configuration issues - volume sizing and autosize, capacity-pool tiering and cooling, throughput/SSD-IOPS fit, SnapMirror replication lag and health, and multi-protocol (NFS+SMB) security-style conflicts - and produces a ranked, read-only-safe remediation plan. Read-only. Recommends a custom ONTAP-REST MCP and the AWS Documentation MCP as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on TUE at 07:00 UTC
